Both required reviews have now been substantively completed, though I'd ask that Marcus add his findings to the contract comments and Talia enter her condition in the partnership tracker for the record. Once those are logged and the draft is updated to reflect these four changes, I can authorize signature. Does anyone disagree with this path forward?
